clipping_definition: fraction of sample-step proposals with any action component outside [-1,1]
common_randomness: one uniform base-action tensor and one standard-normal Wiener tensor per state; all modes reuse the base tensor, A/C reuse Wiener noise, and B uses zeros
crossing_definition: fraction with start normalized Q-budget margin <= 0 and endpoint margin > 0

selection.selection: ascending absolute normalized Q-cost budget margin with stable replay-index tie break
